title: The Extra's Academy Survival Guide
altTitles: The Extra's Academy Survival Guide: How to Survive
The Extra's Academy Survival Guide: A Guide to Surviving
生存指南：学院里的小透明
description: A reader wakes up inside a game as Ed Rothstaylor, a minor villain and an insignificant extra destined to be expelled from the academy. With no intention of becoming the protagonist or getting involved in the original story, Ed simply wants to survive quietly and secure a peaceful life. Unfortunately, the academy's events, characters, and dangerous situations repeatedly drag him into the center of the story, forcing him to use his knowledge and ingenuity to survive.
author: Haechun / Gomguk
